Initial release — AI-powered free video editor generator skill:

- Automatic token acquisition with 100 free credits for new users; session-based project management.
- Simple prompts enable actions like uploading, editing, exporting, checking credits, or reviewing project status.

- Error handling for token/auth issues, file type/size, and export restrictions.
